architectural_units.name: Frontend
architectural_units.description: The mobile application developed with Flutter, which acts as the presentation layer.

architectural_units.name: Backend
architectural_units.description: The server-side software responsible for business logic, data persistence, and integration with external services.

architectural_units.name: Domain Layer (Backend)
architectural_units.description: Contains the purest business logic of the system, as well as domain models and repository interfaces.

architectural_units.name: Application Layer (Backend)
architectural_units.description: Includes the system's use cases, which orchestrate business logic and define the flow of operations.

architectural_units.name: Infrastructure Layer (Backend)
architectural_units.description: Responsible for interaction with the outside, including HTTP views, repositories, and adapters for external services.

architectural_units.name: Presentation Layer (Frontend)
architectural_units.description: Manages the application state and communication with the user interface using Bloc/Cubit.

architectural_units.name: Domain Layer (Frontend)
architectural_units.description: Contains business logic, with use cases, entities, and repositories defined as interfaces.

architectural_units.name: Data Layer (Frontend)
architectural_units.description: Handles data access, including backend calls, data transformation, and concrete repository implementation.

architectural_units.name: Authentication Service
architectural_units.description: Service responsible for managing user authentication, including OTP generation and validation.

architectural_units.name: AI Service
architectural_units.description: External service used for generating response suggestions for reviews.

architectural_units.name: Flutter
architectural_units.description: Framework used for the development of the mobile application.

architectural_units.name: Django
architectural_units.description: Framework used for the construction of the REST API in the backend.

architectural_units.name: MySQL
architectural_units.description: Relational database management system used for data persistence.

architectural_units.name: Gemini
architectural_units.description: AI service integrated for generating review responses.

architectural_units.name: ChatGPT
architectural_units.description: AI service integrated for generating review responses.

architectural_units.name: Firebase
architectural_units.description: Used for complementary functionalities like notifications and associated services.

architectural_units.name: REST API
architectural_units.description: Communication protocol used between frontend and backend.

architectural_units.name: HTTP
architectural_units.description: Protocol used for the REST API communication.

architectural_units.name: JSON
architectural_units.description: Data format used for requests and responses in the API.
The communication between the front-end and the back-end is performed through a REST API, using JSON format messages for both requests and responses.
The back-end integrates various external services, such as artificial intelligence services (Gemini or ChatGPT) and authentication services.
The back-end interacts with the database using the Django ORM.
The system integrates Firebase for complementary functionalities like notifications and associated services.

patterns.name: Client-Server
patterns.description: The interaction with the system is performed through a mobile application that acts as a frontend, making requests to a backend.

patterns.name: Hexagonal Architecture
patterns.description: The back-end follows the Hexagonal Architecture pattern (Ports and Adapters), which allows separating business logic from the framework and infrastructure technologies.

patterns.name: Clean Architecture
patterns.description: The front-end follows an architecture based on the principles of Clean Architecture, applied strictly.

patterns.name: Dependency Inversion
patterns.description: The domain defines interfaces that are implemented by the infrastructure.

patterns.name: Repository Pattern
patterns.description: Isolates data access and simplifies the use of the ORM in use cases.

patterns.name: Factory Pattern
patterns.description: Used to dynamically instantiate artificial intelligence services according to system configuration.

patterns.name: Bloc/Cubit
patterns.description: Pattern used for state management and business logic in the frontend.
